evals.name: isolated-postgres-test
evals.prompt: Write an integration test for a PostgreSQL user repository using testcontainers-go.
evals.expected_output: Test that spins up a container, applies migrations, runs repository assertions, and terminates container.
assertions: Uses testcontainers-go/modules/postgres to spin up real PostgreSQL.
Applies database migrations before running tests.
Tests real SQL insertion, querying, and error handling against the container.

evals.name: local-docker-fallback
evals.prompt: Support running integration tests both in local environments with existing Docker DB and in CI containers.
evals.expected_output: Hybrid test setup checking TEST_DATABASE_URL first before starting Testcontainers.
assertions: Checks environment variable (e.g. TEST_DATABASE_URL) for pre-existing database.
Falls back to spinning up Testcontainers if environment URL is empty.
Uses build tags (//go:build integration) to separate from fast unit tests.

evals.name: testmain-lifecycle
evals.prompt: Structure TestMain to share a database container across repository test cases while isolating test data.
evals.expected_output: TestMain lifecycle managing single container startup and teardown, with per-test schema or transaction isolation.
assertions: Container starts once in TestMain and terminates in defer/after m.Run().
Individual tests run in separate transactions (rolled back) or clean tables.
Passes m.Run() exit code to os.Exit.
